_readme: Canned response bodies for the 'Coastal - Mock Coupa API (TEST)' n8n workflow. One entry per Coupa endpoint used across the 4 API-calling Coupa workflows (Token Regen, Step 1, Step 2, Step 3). Shapes reverse-engineered from the built n8n nodes' field reads (n8n_get_workflow mode=filtered, 2026-07-08) and from docs/functions.js; folds in OQ-028's proven corrections. NO real secrets — token is a placeholder. Deterministic IDs (requisition 424242, PO 555001) are baked in so the mock's mid-path routes can be registered as LITERAL webhook paths (n8n does not match mid-path route params — OQ-028 finding). The Limble sandbox meta fields MUST be seeded to match these IDs (Step 2 WO meta1=424242, Step 3 WO meta2=555001).

_field_read_notes.fullResponse: When the consuming HTTP node has options.response.fullResponse=true, n8n wraps the mock's JSON body as $json.body. The mock still emits only the raw body; the 'body' wrapper is added by n8n. Nodes WITHOUT fullResponse read the raw JSON directly ($json.x). Column tells you which.
_field_read_notes.array_fan_out: For a node WITHOUT fullResponse whose response is a top-level JSON array, n8n fans the array out to one item per element (this is how Step 2's task-list and purchase_orders feed work). Nodes WITH fullResponse do NOT fan out; the array stays under $json.body.

token.consumerReads: $json.access_token (Token Regen 'Refresh Coupa OAuth Token' -> upsert oauth_token)

users.consumerReads: $json.body.length > 0 ('Site Manager Found?' gate). Content is otherwise NOT read — the requisition payload uses the Limble-side siteManager.userEmail, not this response.

addresses.consumerReads: $json.body.length > 0 ('Address Found?'); then body[0].id, body[0]['custom-fields'].entity['external-ref-code'], body[0]['custom-fields'].location['external-ref-code'] (Build Account Segments seg1/seg2 + Build Requisition Payload ship-to-address.id).

accounts.consumerReads: $json.body.length > 0 ('Account Found?'); then body[0].id AND body[0]['account-type'].name (Build Requisition Payload account.id + account.account-type.name).
accounts._note: OQ-028 correction: response MUST include account-type.name — the payload builder dereferences it and would throw otherwise.

suppliers.consumerReads: $json.body.length > 0 ('Supplier Found?'); then body[0].id (Build Requisition Payload supplier.id).
suppliers._supplierFailure: PAYLOAD-DRIVEN, no failMode: if the inbound query display-name contains 'FAIL-SUPPLIER', return []. The supplier-miss path posts contractor-missing comment(s) and writes NO error-log row (faithful asymmetry).

createRequisition.consumerReads: $json.body.id ('Coupa: Create Requisition' -> Update Task meta1 = String(body.id); and the attach URL /api/requisitions/{body.id}/attachments).
createRequisition._note: id MUST be the deterministic 424242 so the attach route literal path resolves, so meta1 stamped on the task is 424242, and so Step 2's GET /api/requisitions/424242 literal path resolves.

requisitionAttachment.consumerReads: Response body NOT read further — success/failure only ('Coupa: Attach Quote').
requisitionAttachment._note: Registered as LITERAL path with the deterministic req id 424242 (OQ-028 finding: n8n does not match /requisitions/:reqId/attachments).

getRequisition.consumerReads: $json.status ('Is Requisition Ordered?' == 'ordered') and $json.id ('Get PO Created From Req.' uses requisition-header[id]={id}). Single object, NOT an array.
getRequisition._note: Registered as LITERAL path with deterministic meta1=424242. Step 2's WO fixture meta1 MUST equal 424242.

purchaseOrders.consumerFullResponse: Step 2: false (array fans out to items; Set task reads .item.json.id and .item.json['po-number']). Step 3: true (reads body[0].id and body[0]['created-by'].fullname).
purchaseOrders.consumerReads: Step 2: [0].id (-> meta2) and [0]['po-number'] (-> description append). Step 3: body[0].id (-> attach/comment URL) and body[0]['created-by'].fullname (-> @mention).
purchaseOrders._note: One canned array serves both. id MUST be deterministic 555001 so Step 3's attach/comment literal paths resolve and so the Step-3 WO fixture meta2=555001 matches.

poAttachment.consumerReads: Response NOT read further ('Coupa: Attach Invoice'). Failure -> error output -> Insert Error Log Row.
poAttachment._note: LITERAL path with deterministic PO id 555001.

poComment.consumerReads: Response NOT read further ('Coupa: Post Comment (Invoice)' and '(No Invoice)'). Failure -> error output -> Insert Error Log Row.
poComment._note: LITERAL path with deterministic PO id 555001. Serves BOTH the invoice-present and no-invoice comment POSTs (same URL/body).
